LESSON: READING ALOUD: FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.2 Reading aloud (2 sessions) • Syllables blending • Simple words By th
Topic 2.4: Reading Aloud: Fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading Aloud: Fluency. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can one improve their reading skills?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read words relating to days of the week accurately

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING ALOUD: FLUENCY
This lesson teaches Reading Aloud: Fluency for Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. read words relating to days of the week accurately
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading Aloud: Fluency using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading Aloud: Fluency above.
2. Explain Reading Aloud: Fluency to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading Aloud: Fluency.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading Aloud: Fluency with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading Aloud: Fluency important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can one improve their reading skills?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read words relating to days of the week accurately

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
